productSupportClaimScope: App Router preview adapter in apps/preview-service (multi-route, layout, link navigation, HMR). Not a claim of full desktop next CLI / native SWC parity.

scope.goal: Keep the App Router adapter product-supported and validate the pinned full Next runtime before browser-worker promotion.

browserWorker.reason: The real Next 15.1.0 CommonJS CLI entry cannot execute under the release CSP without dynamic code generation, so dev/build/start and downstream full-runtime features are not browser-worker validated.

security.reason: Pinned Next 15.1.0 is an intentionally retained compatibility fixture, not a release-eligible security baseline.

capabilities.reason: NextProductWorkflow serves app/**/page.tsx with layout wrapping, next/link navigation, and save-triggered preview refresh in the product IDE.
Preview path maps to app route segments (e.g. /about -> app/about/page.tsx).
Adapter writes out/index.html smoke artifacts for product build button.

capabilities.command: next dev | next build | next start
capabilities.reason: The pinned Next 15.1.0 distribution is mounted and its real CLI dev, build, and start paths pass in the Node-hosted guest runtime integration fixture. Strict-CSP browser-worker execution remains hold.
The real Next 15.1.0 development server compiles the App Router with version-matched WASM SWC and serves the rendered route.
The real Next 15.1.0 build emits BUILD_ID, RSC/client manifests, middleware and Edge bundles, prerender metadata, server chunks, and production assets.
May become supportable after WASM SWC and build-time filesystem contracts are verified; runtime server features remain out of scope.
Native platform packages and native .node addons are outside the browser runtime support scope.

The integrity-pinned, version-matched @next/swc-wasm-nodejs 15.1.0 transform path is used by the Node-hosted real next dev and next build validation. It is not promoted for strict-CSP browser workers while the CLI entry is blocked.
Production RSC manifests are emitted and a real Server Action POST returns the expected 303 action redirect.
Middleware response mutation and an Edge-runtime route execute through the production server fixture.
ISR transitions from stale to regenerated cache content and Image Optimization returns byte-exact PNG data.

gate.supportDecision: The App Router preview adapter remains the public product-supported surface. The pinned full runtime stays candidate-grade: Node-hosted guest-runtime evidence passes, but strict-CSP browser-worker preflight and the release security baseline are hold. Native .node SWC remains unsupported; only the integrity-pinned, version-matched WASM package is permitted.
